description: Search live jobs on Haystack, newest first. Filter by job title words, country, city, remote, and by what the advert says: no experience needed, no degree needed, visa sponsorship offered. Returns up to 20 jobs, each with its link, and an Auto Apply link when Haystack's AI agent can fill in and submit the employer's form.

auto_apply_only.description: Only roles Haystack's AI agent can apply to.

country.description: Country name or code, e.g. 'United States', 'UK', 'Canada', 'Germany'.

no_degree.description: Only roles whose advert says no degree is needed (or asks for a high school diploma or equivalent).

no_experience.description: Only roles whose advert says no experience is needed or training is provided.

query.description: Words in the job title, e.g. 'product manager', 'nurse', 'data analyst'.

visa_sponsorship.description: Only roles whose advert says the employer offers visa sponsorship.

name: search_jobs
title: Search live jobs
